lead: A `Scope::Path` capability root in a case's `nvs.toml` has to be absolute; a relative one refuses everything while reading like a grant.
body: `nvs_config::capability`'s matcher canonicalises the queried path and asks `path.starts_with(root)` with the root as written, so `read = ["scratch.db"]` never matches and the refusal is the ordinary "not granted" sentence. Grant an absolute root; `:memory:` is not a path and cannot be granted.
